name: icon-extract
desc: Free, open-source icon extractor for Windows — pull every icon size from exe, dll and ico files to PNG. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **All embedded sizes** — every icon group inside a binary listed from 16 px up to 256 px PNG-compressed frames
✅ **Batch folder scan** — walk a folder of exe and dll files and extract every icon group automatically
✅ **PNG and ICO output** — save as PNG for design tools or repack selected sizes into a fresh ICO
✅ **Preview grid** — see the actual icons before extracting, grouped by resource ID
✅ **Corner-case handling** — handles PE resources, cursor files and multi-language icon groups
✅ **No file modification** — read-only extraction; source binaries are never touched
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Batch folder extraction | **Yes** | Partial | No | No |
| PNG export with alpha | **Yes** | Yes | Explorer only | Partial |
| Repack selected sizes to ICO | **Yes** | No | No | Yes |
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Zip | Installer | Zip |
faqQ: how to extract icons from exe files on Windows?
faqA: Explorer shows one icon per binary and hides the rest, while resource editors make you hunt inside unfamiliar dialogs. icon-extract lists every embedded size, previews them grouped by ID and exports clean alpha PNGs or repacked ICOs. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline and strictly read-only.
s1: Dark grid (#121418, yellow #FACC15): binaries list left, icon group grid right with size badges 16 through 256, checkboxes per size.
s2: Extraction options: PNG or ICO output segmented control, filename pattern field, alpha preserved badge, target folder picker.
s3: Batch run: folder scan result of 38 binaries and 412 icons, progress at 81 percent, log line reading no source files modified.
